description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'CoreFixtureService' class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides utility methods for managing test fixtures, including saving fixtures to the database and checking fixture readiness.

classes.name: CoreFixtureService
classes.description: A utility service class for managing test fixtures, including registration, saving, and validation within the OrangeHRM testing environment.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of TextHelperService used within the class.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Retrieves the Doctrine EntityManager instance for database interactions.

methods.name: saveToFixtures
methods.description: Iterates over registered fixtures and dumps them into the database, with a safety check for test database connections.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if all fixture files are present in the fixtures directory, indicating readiness.
